block.comment: Measure the voltage on this analog input. On ATmega168/328, the ADC returns 0–1023; other boards may use a different ADC range. A potentiometer wiper or analog sensor connects here.
Convert a value from one numeric range to another. All five inputs can be expressions. Arduino map uses integer arithmetic and does not clamp values outside the source range.
Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.

Purpose: Map an A0 potentiometer reading to PWM brightness for an LED. A PWM output is required for analogWrite. Wiring: analog write: PIN D9; analog read: PIN A0; Potentiometer outer legs VCC/GND; wiper on the listed analog input. Common GND; use each module’s required supply. Try: Change the map output maximum from 255 to 80 to limit LED brightness.
